# std.valkey

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

A Valkey (or Redis) client. One client is a multiplexed connection that
reconnects on failure: share it between tasks, each command parks its
task until the reply. Typed helpers cover the common commands;
`command` sends any other (its reply is `Data`). Blocking commands
(`BLPOP`, `XREAD BLOCK`) hold the shared connection while they wait:
give them a client of their own.

## Types

### `Client`

```lang
struct Client { handle: native.Handle, url: String }
```

A connection to one server (`valkey://`, `valkeys://` for TLS, or the
`redis://` spellings, with an optional `user:password@` and `/db`).


## Functions

### `client`

```lang
client: system.Provider<{url: String}, valkey.Client, valkey.Error>
```

Provider of a client for `{url: String}`, closed when the system halts.

### `close`

```lang
fn close(client: Client) -> Unit
```

Close the connection (also done once the client is unreachable).

### `connect`

```lang
fn connect(url: String) -> Result<Client, Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Connect to the server at `url`.
